_comment: Scenario battery for Acacia Healing's Node 2 (claude-haiku-4-5). Created 2026-08-21 when Sharon Kennedy (the sole practitioner for Access Bars, Motivation Maps, Motivation Strategy, and Integrated Reset) was deactivated and those branches were removed from CLINIC_CONFIGS['acacia_healing'] in scripts/node2_configs.py. Updated 2026-09-09 when the 6 Remedial Bodywork appointment types (Liana Smart's sole service) were marked ai_visible=false and the REMEDIAL_BODYWORK sub-path was removed from the STRUCTURAL_INTEGRATION branch (and all other Remedial Bodywork/Liana Smart references) in scripts/node2_configs.py -- pre-existing 'Remedial Bodywork' mentions in the older sharon-deactivation/womens-hormone-workshop expected_behavior strings were also corrected to match the new service list. See .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: sharon-services-not-offered-access-bars

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an Access Bars session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats 'Access Bars' as not offered and outputs the NOT_OFFERED template naming the current service list (Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy), asking if one of those works. FAIL if the agent asks a gate/variant question for Access Bars, calls confirm_service with an Access Bars appointment_type_id, or otherwise proceeds as if Access Bars is still bookable.

scenarios.name: sharon-services-not-offered-motivation-coaching

history.content: Can I book a motivation coaching session, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats motivation coaching (Motivation Maps / Motivation Strategy / Integrated Reset) as not offered and outputs the NOT_OFFERED template naming the current service list, asking if one of those works. FAIL if the agent asks a sub-type question for motivation coaching or calls confirm_service with any motivation-related appointment_type_id.

scenarios.name: sharon-name-no-longer-matches-any-practitioner

history.content: I'd like to book with Sharon please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does not phonetically match 'Sharon' to any remaining practitioner (Chris, Janelle, Manon, Monica, Nicole, Steph) and does not claim Sharon offers any service, instead falling back to asking what service the caller wants (e.g. outputting MENU_LIST). FAIL if the agent invents a match to a different practitioner, claims Sharon is available, or references Access Bars/Motivation Maps/Motivation Strategy/Integrated Reset as things Sharon offers.

scenarios.name: menu-list-no-longer-lists-access-bars-or-motivation

history.content: Hi, I'd like to make a booking.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if MENU_LIST fires and lists exactly: Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy — with correct 'and' placement before the final item. FAIL if Access Bars or Motivation Coaching is mentioned anywhere in the spoken output.

scenarios.name: womens-hormone-workshop-direct-booking

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book Monica's free information evening please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent matches this to the WOMENS_HORMONE_WORKSHOP category, does NOT ask a new/returning-patient gate question or any duration question (DIRECT archetype, no gate), speaks one filler phrase, and calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type="Women's Hormone Health Workshop - 7 September 5.30pm" and appointment_type_id="2019403327049046439" in the same turn. FAIL if the agent asks a gate/variant question, asks about payment/price unprompted, uses a different appointment_type_id, or treats this as not offered (NOT_OFFERED template).

scenarios.name: womens-hormone-workshop-alt-phrasing

history.content: I saw something about a hormone health workshop, can I get a spot?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent matches 'hormone health workshop' to the WOMENS_HORMONE_WORKSHOP category via the CATEGORY TABLE and proceeds to call confirm_service with appointment_type_id "2019403327049046439" (with a filler phrase first, no gate question). FAIL if the agent treats this as an unmatched/NOT_OFFERED service or asks a clarifying question instead of routing directly.

scenarios.name: menu-list-still-excludes-womens-hormone-workshop

history.content: Hi, I'd like to make a booking.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if MENU_LIST fires and lists exactly: Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy — the workshop is booked only on request, not proactively offered. FAIL if the Women's Hormone Health Workshop or 'information evening' is mentioned in the unprompted MENU_LIST output.

scenarios.name: remedial-bodywork-not-offered

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a Remedial Bodywork session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats 'Remedial Bodywork' as not offered and outputs the NOT_OFFERED template naming the current service list (Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy), asking if one of those works. FAIL if the agent asks a gate/duration question for Remedial Bodywork, routes into the STRUCTURAL_INTEGRATION_SI flow silently, calls confirm_service with any of the 6 retired Remedial Bodywork appointment_type_ids (1898163663450151526, 1898213978765531765, 1898213889007426164, 1898214363534203510, 1898214623337781879, 1898214894273043064), or otherwise proceeds as if Remedial Bodywork is still bookable.

scenarios.name: bodywork-keyword-alone-not-offered

history.content: Do you do bodywork? I'd like to book that.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT silently route 'bodywork' into the STRUCTURAL_INTEGRATION category (that keyword was removed from the CATEGORY TABLE) — it should either ask a clarifying question or fall through to NOT_OFFERED/MENU_LIST. FAIL if the agent asks 'Have you had Structural Integration with us before?' or calls confirm_service with a Structural Integration appointment_type_id without the caller ever mentioning Structural Integration, Chris, SI, or rolfing.

scenarios.name: liana-smart-name-no-longer-matches-a-service

history.content: I'd like to book with Liana Smart please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does not claim Liana offers Remedial Bodywork or any other bookable service, does not ask 'Have you seen Liana before?', and does not route to the retired REMEDIAL_BODYWORK path — instead falling back to asking what service the caller wants (e.g. outputting MENU_LIST or NOT_OFFERED). FAIL if the agent proceeds as if Liana Smart still offers a bookable service, or references Remedial Bodywork as something she does.

scenarios.name: structural-integration-with-chris-still-works

history.content: I'd like to book Structural Integration with Chris please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent skips any structural-vs-bodywork disambiguation question, goes straight to the STRUCTURAL_INTEGRATION_SI flow, and asks 'Have you had Structural Integration with us before?' (or the OTHER variant). FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose between Structural Integration and Remedial Bodywork, mentions Remedial Bodywork at all, or fails to recognize Structural Integration as a valid category.

scenarios.name: menu-list-no-longer-lists-remedial-bodywork

history.content: Hi, I'd like to make a booking.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if MENU_LIST fires and lists exactly: Remedial Massage, Lymphatic Drainage, Structural Integration, Healing with Nutrition, and Naturopathy — with correct 'and' placement before the final item, and Remedial Bodywork is NOT mentioned. FAIL if Remedial Bodywork or Liana Smart is mentioned anywhere in the spoken output.
